slides.subtitle: ENGS 28 · Day 1 — In-Class

slides.title: Welcome to ENGS 28
items: No pre-class reading today — this is our first meeting.
You need your laptop with STM32CubeIDE installed.
You'll get a Nucleo board and a USB cable in class.
By the end of today you'll make an LED blink — and understand every line that does it.
